title: Studio Access: scrolling the permission matrix sideways hides the field Read and Edit boxes under the sticky name cell
body:
epic:#28130#1 · hotlong · session_040dfd80c4c9411b895c698e785a6848

Filing gate: ① a measured break. Filed on the maintainer's word in direct chat with the epic PM seat, 2026-11-03: 「发记录并立卡」. ⛔ Not a claim.
QA-source: #29672 · studio-authoring.permission-matrix-editor-ux · off-clause
Reader: `domain:ui`.
Dedupe: `permission matrix sticky`. **New.**
type: Bug

Runner reading on `main` at `3482f3d8d2`, on two fresh loads, not re-derived by the PM seat. Studio Access, a writable set, expand an object, scroll `perm-matrix-pane` to the right. The sticky `perm-field-name-OBJ-FIELD` cell (697 px wide) covers both field boxes: `document.elementFromPoint` at the box centre returns that cell from scrollLeft 80 up, and not at 0, 40 or 57. The matrix needs that scroll below 1304 px of pane width, so a narrow pane cannot reach them.

Wanted: the boxes stay reachable while scrolled. Add the clause to the item, whose clause 5 covers only the Bulk column.

Links back: #29672.
